test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Adversary
solution:
The correct answer is 'Opponent'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's see the **meaning **of the given word and the marked answer:

 
 
• Adversary: a country or person you are fighting or competing against.

 
 
• Example: Like the trained warrior that I was, I knew not to oppose an **adversary **head-on.
 
 
 
• Opponent: someone who competes against or fights another in a contest, game, or argument; a rival or adversary.
 
 
• Example: Leading **opponents **of the proposed cuts in defence spending will meet later today.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, from the above explanation, it can be seen that the possible synonym for the word 'Adversary' is 'Opponent'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's see the **meaning** of the other options as well:

 
 
• **Uniform**: the same; not changing or different in any way
 
• Companion: someone or something you spend a lot of time with or travel with, or a friend who lives with you.
 
• Prudent: acting with or showing care and thought for the future.
